closureStatement: NONE. The k = 6 band is NOT closed by this round. What is closed is the flatDim half of it for T12c_absorb_best.ts: of the 74613 size-6 drop sets, 61656 are refuted outright because their deficit's axis-slice dimensions exceed the largest j that still lands at rank <= 22 (j <= k - (r-22) = 6 for a 22-term base). The remaining 12957 size-6 T12c drop sets survive the flattening screen and were NOT reached by the box-cover screen, so they are UNRESOLVED - not refuted, and not to be read as refuted. The k=6 bands of T11_solution.ts and T12d_fam_B.ts were not enumerated at all.
whyItStalled: The flatDim half is cheap (0.94 ms per drop set, 70s for all 74613). The box-cover half is not: R64 needed more than one full round window for 1986 covers, and the size-6 survivor fraction is 17.4% (12957 of 74613) against 5.7% at k=5, so the exact branch and bound cannot be the right tool at this k without first adding a cheap PROVEN lower bound. tools/boxCover.ts's tier-1 capacity bound ceil(|supp| / maxBoxSize) costs about 2.6e5 mask pairs per survivor, which is itself the bottleneck at this survivor count. The concrete next step, not taken here, is an incompatibility-clique bound: two support points share a valid box if and only if the de-duplicated product box through them lies inside supp (validity is downward closed), so a set of pairwise non-boxable points each needs its own box, and a greedy clique in that incompatibility graph is a proven lower bound costing O(|supp|^2) set lookups instead of a search.
exactArithmetic: box cover is integer index arithmetic over 9-bit masks with no float equality anywhere; flatDim is R61's exact rational Gaussian elimination over BigInt via tools/rational.rref, re-imported and re-run here rather than trusted from JSON
claimDiscipline: Only `provenLower > j` refutes. provenLower is ceil(|supp| / maxBoxSize), a proven per-box capacity bound needing no search, or the exact branch-and-bound minimum. `upper <= j` is never claimed as a witness. No coefficient solve was attempted at any k, so no scheme is claimed and none is exported.
honestLimits: nothing here is a bound on rank 22 itself; R stays in [19, 23] over Q/R whatever this round reports
the 12957 surviving size-6 T12c drop sets are UNRESOLVED, not refuted, and no partial reading of them is licensed
the k=6 bands of T11_solution.ts and T12d_fam_B.ts were not run; R64's k=5 closure of them is untouched and still stands
boxCover <= j is support feasibility only, NOT a witness: the coefficient solve is a separate bilinear problem
the screen does not cover repairs that change the surviving terms, add non-rank-1 factors, or start from a base other than T12c / T11 / T12d_fam_B
the Q/R field is the one claimed; the box condition is field-free, so box-cover refutations also hold over Z and every F_p
verdictMeaning: an honest bounded result, not an impossibility: one screen (flatDim) was extended to the exact k=6 band for one of three bases and refuted 61656 of 74613 size-6 drop sets, the second screen (box cover) did not reach the 12957 that survive it, and the other two bases were not enumerated. The k=6 band remains open.
